nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the black-haired woman spy established in the references: long straight black hair, pale skin, purple beret, ornate black-and-gold masquerade mask, dark gothic coat with purple trim, high-collared blouse, gloves, layered skirt, tights, and heeled boots. She moves with stealth, precision, and controlled aggression.

<Subject 2> is the blonde woman spy established in the references: shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, pale skin, ornate masquerade mask, fitted dark red gothic jacket over black lace clothing, waist chain, dark skirt, tights, and boots. She is poised, agile, and confident in close combat.

<Subject 3> is the masked male guard established in the references: formal dark suit, white shirt, bow tie, masquerade mask, and short dark hair. He is an enemy target inside the library room.

<Subject 4> is the masked female guard established in the references: formal black outfit, hair tied back, masquerade mask, and defensive posture. She is a second enemy target inside the library room.

<Picture 1> is the setup reference for the approach: <Subject 1> opens a heavy carved door while <Subject 2> waits nearby in the corridor, both preparing to enter the room quietly.

<Picture 2> is the combat reference showing <Subject 1> ambushing <Subject 3> from behind inside a book-lined library while <Subject 2> enters through the open doorway.

<Picture 3> is the combat reference showing <Subject 2> attacking <Subject 4> in the library while <Subject 1> remains near the doorway as lookout and support.

summary:

[reference generation] A covert fight scene unfolds in a gothic library off the main church corridor. The two masked women spies quietly enter, then immediately split their targets: <Subject 1> silently restrains the masked male guard while <Subject 2> engages the masked female guard. The action is fast, elegant, and tactical, with both women fighting efficiently in the dim candlelit room.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - retain her exact outfit, mask, purple beret, stealthy demeanor, and tactical role as the first attacker and doorway support.

<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - retain her blonde hair, red-and-black outfit, lace details, and assertive fighting role.

<Subject 3>: fully_preserved - retain the male guard’s formal attire and position as the first ambushed opponent.

<Subject 4>: fully_preserved - retain the female guard’s formal dark look and role as the second combatant.

<Picture 1>: partially_preserved - use it as the entry setup and opening action.

<Picture 2>: fully_preserved - use it as the central action reference for <Subject 1> ambushing <Subject 3>.

<Picture 3>: fully_preserved - use it as the follow-up action reference for <Subject 2> attacking <Subject 4> while <Subject 1> controls the room.

detailed_description:

The video takes place in the same gothic environment established by the references: a dim stone corridor leading into a richly furnished library with tall bookshelves, carved wooden doors, candle sconces, and warm low light. Treat the scene as a short continuous action sequence with a clear progression from stealth entry to close-quarters combat. Do not introduce unnecessary cuts beyond what is needed to follow the action.

[Shot 1] Begin with the visual setup from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> quietly pulls open the heavy carved door and peers into the room. <Subject 2> waits just outside, alert and ready, her body angled toward the doorway. Their movements are cautious, quiet, and coordinated. The corridor behind them remains empty and dim, emphasizing secrecy.

[Shot 2] They enter the library. The room is lined with shelves full of old books and lit by warm candlelight. As soon as the opening is clear, <Subject 1> moves decisively toward <Subject 3>. Following the action established by <Picture 2>, she slips behind him and locks him into a tight restraining hold from the rear, controlling his upper body and preventing him from calling out. Her expression stays focused and composed. At the same time, <Subject 2> crosses through the doorway into the room, scanning for the second threat.

[Shot 3] The second enemy moves, and <Subject 2> engages immediately. Following the action logic of <Picture 3>, she strikes <Subject 4> with a sharp, controlled attack that knocks the guard backward. The movement should feel fast and practiced rather than wild. <Subject 4> loses balance and falls back under the force of the hit. While this happens, <Subject 1> remains aware of the doorway and room perimeter, either releasing <Subject 3> only after disabling him or keeping him contained while watching the entrance.

The overall fight style is efficient, spy-like, and elegant: quick takedowns, minimal wasted motion, and no exaggerated brawling. Preserve the women’s outfits and masks throughout. End with the room under their control, both enemies neutralized or subdued, and the two women still alert inside the library.

overall_soundscape:

Quiet gothic interior ambience with soft room reverb, distant cathedral hush, subtle fabric movement, quick footsteps on stone, the creak of the heavy wooden door, brief scuffling during grappling, body impacts, and the rustle of clothing. No spoken dialogue is required.
